channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE tem maioria para Meta assegurar isonomia entre Flávio e Lula nas redes
item.description: The TSE formed a majority to ensure parity between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) on Meta's social media platforms, following a decision by Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze.

item.title: Lula diz que “Globo” está contra ele após fim de bets e prisão de Vorcaro
item.description: At a campaign rally in Ipatinga, Lula accused TV Globo of opposing his candidacy, linking the alleged media stance to the end of horse racing subsidies, the 6x1 work schedule, and the arrest of Daniel Vorcaro. He claimed the network is under suspicion and referenced Trump, Milei, and the Master case as electoral opponents.

item.title: Dark Horse: PF pede mais 90 dias para investigação sobre filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police requested an additional 90 days from the Supreme Court to investigate the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', which depicts Jair Bolsonaro, amid suspicions of irregularities involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro. The investigation, part of the Master case, probes money laundering, currency flight, and organized crime.

item.title: Derrite é o preferido de Flávio Bolsonaro para a Segurança Pública
item.description: Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) is the leading name to head the Ministry of Public Security, if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 elections. So far, there has been no formal invitation between the two, according to sources close to them. Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is also mentioned as a potential candidate for the position.

item.title: PF pede mais 90 dias para investigar Dark Horse
item.description: The Federal Police requested a 90-day extension to investigate the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic about Jair Bolsonaro, with suspicions of money laundering and currency evasion. Among those investigated is Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, and the case involves approximately R$134 million and $12.3 million transferred abroad.

item.title: Advogado do Master tentou aproximar Daniel Vorcaro de esposa do ministro Cueva
item.description: Fábio Medina, lawyer for Banco Master, offered Daniel Vorcaro an invitation to a Brasília event promising contact with Justice Minister Cueva and his wife. Vorcaro declined due to family commitments, missing the event. Investigation reveals the minister's wife had no connection to Banco Master's business deals.

item.title: TSE forma maioria para determinar que Meta não interfira em conteúdo de Flávio e Lula
item.description: TSE ruled that Meta must not interfere with electoral content distribution of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, upholding a decision by Justice Marco Aurélio. The ruling was supported by three ministers, with a daily fine of $100,000 for non-compliance. The lawsuit alleges preferential content creation by Meta AI.

item.title: Dark Horse: Delator relata fraude em pagamento a fundo ligado a Eduardo Bolsonaro nos EUA
item.description: Businessman Antônio Carlos Freixo Júnior, in his plea bargain, told the Federal Police that a $12.3 million transfer to a U.S. fund allegedly to finance the movie 'Dark Horse' involved fraud and was disguised as a real estate investment. The money allegedly originated from Banco Master and is linked to Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro, both under investigation in the case.

item.title: Lula envia nos próximos dias PEC do ônibus de graça aos fins de semana
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will send a PEC to Congress in the coming days proposing free weekend bus fares, funded by parliamentary amendments. The measure, which requires debate with lawmakers, was announced before the second round of the presidential election. Campaign coordinator Camilo Santana emphasized the issue's relevance to urban mobility.

item.title: A campanha de Lula e o panelaço na entrevista de Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo
item.description: Supporters of Lula were called to stage a pot-banging protest during Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on Globo, but opposing guidance emerged, questioning the protest's effectiveness and impact. The debate reflects polarization between followers of the two leaders. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Zanin relata ação do PSD para tentar restabelecer segundo turno no Rio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin was randomly assigned to oversee a lawsuit filed by the PSD party aiming to restore the second-round gubernatorial election in Rio de Janeiro, scheduled for October 25th. The lawsuit challenges the legality of the move eliminating the runoff.

item.title: Lula diz que “Globo” está sob “suspeição” após almoço com Flávio
item.description: President Lula claimed TV Globo is under suspicion after Senator Flávio Bolsonaro had lunch with the network's executives before an interview. He accused the media of discontent with government measures such as the gambling crackdown and the end of the 6x1 work schedule, as well as the arrest of businessman Daniel Vorcaro. Lula leveraged the episode to rally support against the right-wing ahead of the reelection race.

item.title: Meta diz não interferir em eleições no Brasil e descreve problemas como 'incidentes técnicos'
item.description: Meta released a statement asserting it did not interfere in the Brazilian elections and labeled as 'technical incidents' the episodes cited by a Folha report. The company found no intentional misconduct in its electoral activities.

item.title: Meta cita ‘falha’, mas nega interferência nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: Meta denied interference in the Brazilian elections following reports of technical failures that affected the distribution of Lula's campaign content on WhatsApp and Instagram, including issues with view counts and blocked promotions. The TSE banned the platform from restricting political-election content, requiring prior human analysis to disable candidates' advertising accounts.

item.title: Debate na Band no segundo turno: o que esperar do primeiro confronto entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The first runoff debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro takes place on Band, with Lula two points behind (45%) and Flávio leading (47%). Flávio initially refused to attend but confirmed after Lula's statement, vowing to 'rub the truth in his face' during the clash. Coverage will be live with post-debate analysis.

item.title: TSE tem maioria para manter decisão que proíbe Meta de limitar alcance de conteúdo político e favorecer candidatos
item.description: The TSE ruled that Meta cannot restrict the reach of political content or favor candidates such as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The decision aims to ensure equal treatment in content distribution and AI use during the election. Justice Bellizze emphasized preventive measures but found no evidence of deliberate manipulation by the company.

item.title: A estratégia de Camilo Santana de colocar redução da maioridade penal na mesa
item.description: Camilo Santana, PT leader in the Senate, proposed lowering the age of majority to 16 for heinous crimes, aiming to set the government's stance and dilute a more radical opposition amendment.

item.title: Senado avalia ampliar idade mínima para ministro do STF para tentar reduzir influência de eventual governo Flávio
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre leads an effort to raise the minimum age for Supreme Court justices from 35 to 50, aiming to limit the power of potential future governments like Flávio Bolsonaro's. The strategy includes a constitutional amendment and the nomination of Rodrigo Pacheco to the Court. The Lula administration favors broad reforms, but negotiations are expected to advance after the runoff election.

item.title: Nunes Marques ganha holofote com estratégia do STF de se manter discreto
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, head of the TSE, has come under scrutiny due to alleged non-republican ties with former banker Daniel Vorcaro and his rulings in electoral cases involving presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Under mounting pressure, a faction within the STF adopted a restraint strategy to prevent inter-court rifts in the runoff, aiming to avoid reinforcing persecutorial narratives against the TSE.

item.title: Datafolha: 96% pretendem ir votar no 2º turno; 1% diz que não vai
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on October 16, 2026 shows that 96% of Brazilian voters plan to vote in the second round, with only 1% saying they won't vote and 3% still undecided. Among supporters of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), 98% of each group confirmed their intention to vote, while 63% of those intending to vote blank or null also plan to go to the polls. The survey, commissioned by Folha de S.Paulo, interviewed 2,520 voters between October 13 and 14, with a margin of error of ±2 percentage points.

item.title: Garotinho diz que quem convive com Lula não o suporta: “É mentiroso”
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Anthony Garotinho criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, labeling him a liar in a post on X. Garotinho referenced a clip from Lula's interview with TV Globo regarding the adjustment of the family allowance and claimed that those who live with Lula cannot stand him due to his alleged dishonesty. The statement underscores the ongoing political polarization in Brazil.

item.title: TSE forma maioria para manter decisão que determinou que Meta não interfira em distribuição de conteúdo político-eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ruled, by majority, that Meta must not interfere in the distribution of political-electoral content during the second-round election, facing a daily fine of R$500,000. The decision responds to a lawsuit filed by Lula's campaign, which accused the platform of unequal treatment toward the candidates. Meta was also instructed to apply identical criteria in AI tools, such as Meta AI, to both campaigns.

item.title: TSE manda Flávio Bolsonaro apagar publicação que afirma que Lula fecharia igrejas
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha ordered Flávio Bolsonaro to remove a post accusing Lula of closing churches, deemed irregular negative electoral propaganda for spreading false facts and offending the opponent's honor.

item.title: Meta nega interferência nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: Meta issued a statement denying interference in the 2026 elections but acknowledged technical glitches affecting Lula's campaign and other candidates. The company clarified that the issues impacted users globally and that around 70% of the restrictions on Lula's accounts stemmed from TSE decisions.

item.title: Camilo chama de “inoportuno” almoço de Flávio com a cúpula da “Globo”
item.description: Senator Camilo Santana (PT-CE) deemed it inappropriate the lunch held by PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro with executives from TV Globo on the same day of an interview with the candidate. The criticism was made at Lula's campaign headquarters, raising concerns about impartiality and the broadcaster's mediating role during the electoral dispute. Other allies also expressed concern about the meeting.

item.title: A expectativa da campanha de Lula para o confronto com Flávio na Band
item.description: Lula's campaign viewed the recent TV Globo interview positively, highlighting a more statesmanlike tone. Polls show a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with focus on the upcoming debate on Band. Allies believe the direct confrontation could consolidate momentum and mobilize supporters in the final week.

item.title: Paulo Vieira ironiza visita de Flávio Bolsonaro à Globo antes de sabatina no Jornal Nacional
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited TV Globo hours before a Jornal Nacional interview, sparking criticism over potential differential treatment compared to Lula. Comedian Paulo Vieira mocked the visit, claiming he was barred from Lula's green room to avoid impartiality concerns.

item.title: Dólar cai 0,28% e Bolsa registra alta de 0,54%
item.description: The dollar fell 0.28% and the Ibovespa rose 0.54%, driven by economic data and electoral uncertainty. Markets monitor the Selic rate at 13.75% and the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Datafolha: 96% pretendem ir votar no 2º turno; 1% diz não ter intenção de comparecer
item.description: Datafolha poll shows that 96% of Brazilian voters intend to vote in the 2026 second round election, with 1% saying they will not attend the polls and 3% still undecided. The high voting intention reflects significant popular engagement in the October election.

item.title: Datafolha: Reformas no STF são defendidas pela maioria que vota em Flávio Bolsonaro e em Lula
item.description: A majority of Brazilians support reforms in the STF, such as term limits for justices and an end to single-judge decisions. A Datafolha survey reveals consensus on judicial reforms, highlighting lower court trials for privileged individuals.

item.title: Dani Lima: Campanha de Flávio minimiza afunilamento da diferença com Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign downplays Lula's (PT) electoral growth and maintains a confident discourse in the final stretch. Journalist Daniela Lima notes the strategy avoids highlighting the PT candidate's gains.

item.title: O que explica a volta de ‘O Conto da Aia’ à lista dos livros mais vendidos de VEJA
item.description: The return of 'The Handmaid's Tale' to VEJA's bestseller lists reflects concerns about the rise of the far right and threats to democracy, with parallels drawn between fiction and recent political episodes involving allies of Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Assista a vídeos em que Lula dizia ser contra reduzir maioridade penal
item.description: Lula previously supported maintaining the age of criminal responsibility at 18, criticizing proposals to reduce it. On October 15, 2026, during a live interview on Globo, he expressed support for lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 in cases of heinous crimes. This shift in stance sparked controversy and is linked to the Public Security Amendment Bill (PEC).

item.title: Pesquisa Lula e Flávio no segundo turno: veja quem está na frente nos levantamentos mais recentes
item.description: Recent polls show Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading the runoff against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), with 47% of voting intentions versus 44.8%. The Lula administration holds 46.8% approval among aggregated voters. The Rali tool, developed by GLOBO and Instituto Locomotiva, consolidates data from institutes like Datafolha, Quaest, and Ipespe to track voting trends and government evaluations.

item.title: Damares pede a líderes religiosos que “não deixem o povo ser enganado”
item.description: Senator Damares Alves asked religious leaders to combat misinformation about Flávio Bolsonaro's proposals for Social Security and social programs, warning that elderly and vulnerable people may be misled.

item.title: Senador do PL promete dinheiro de emendas a cidades com mais votos em Flávio: especialistas veem indício de crime eleitoral
item.description: Senator Reinaldo Azambuja (PL) promised to allocate parliamentary amendments to reward municipalities with more votes for Flávio Bolsonaro, a move viewed by experts as an electoral crime and abuse of power. He coordinated the action with senators Tereza Cristina (PP) and Capitão Contar (PL), suggesting a vote-conditioned reward strategy.

item.title: Composição da Câmara dos Deputados, o que mudou de 2022 para 2026?
item.description: In 2026, the Chamber of Deputies remains led by the PL, which gains 23 more seats, while the PT increases by just one. Female participation rises, but minority representation falls, maintaining a majority of white men with higher education.

item.title: Em aceno a Cleitinho, Lula diz que reconstruirá Minas Gerais
item.description: Lula claimed he is the only chance for Cleitinho Azevedo to recover Minas Gerais, suggesting projects will stall if he doesn't win the election. Cleitinho, elected by Republicans, supported Flávio Roscoe in the second round, while Lula seeks to boost his candidacy with criticism of former governor Romeu Zema.

item.title: Câmara vai implementar fim da 6x1 na semana que vem, diz Motta
item.description: The President of the Chamber of Deputies, Hugo Motta, announced that the House will implement the end of the 6x1 work schedule next week, following the enactment of the constitutional amendment reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours over 14 months. The measure benefits approximately 1,700 civil servants with gradual hour reductions and two paid days off, without salary impact.

item.title: Janones convoca "panelaço" durante sabatina de Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo
item.description: André Janones called for supporters to stage a 'pot-banging' protest during Jair Bolsonaro's interview on TV Globo, sharing a video on social media to encourage the demonstration. The action takes place during the campaign for the presidential runoff election on October 25, where Bolsonaro will face Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Após polêmica com apoiadores de Lula e Flávio, TSE define critérios para vincular canais de WhatsApp a campanhas
item.description: The TSE approved a resolution establishing criteria to link WhatsApp channels and online forums to electoral campaigns, requiring identified channels to be registered with the Electoral Justice and potentially suspended for spreading prohibited content. The measure follows controversies involving channels linked to supporters of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Campanha de Lula se irrita com almoço de Flávio na Globo
item.description: Lula's allies expressed discomfort over an alleged unequal media treatment after Flávio Bolsonaro met with TV Globo executives. The network stated that the meeting was held privately by João Roberto Marinho and Paulo Tonet, with no journalists involved. The incident occurs amid the 2026 election context, further escalating tensions between the candidates.

item.title: Crusoé: Ônibus de graça de Lula é inconstitucional e inviável
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced he will submit a Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC) to establish free buses on weekends. The initiative was criticized by Crusoé, a column from Folha de S.Paulo, which deemed it unconstitutional and politically unfeasible. The announcement was made through a video on Lula’s social media.

item.title: Janones celebra volta do ‘Exército do Lula’: “Está praticamente reeleito”
item.description: André Janones celebrated the reactivation of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel after a TSE dispute, claiming he taught the left to handle digital algorithms. He stated that Lula is practically reelected with the channel's support.

item.title: Leia e assista ao discurso de Alcolumbre na promulgação do fim da 6 X 1
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre presided over a solemn session formalizing amendments that end the 6 X 1 shift schedule and secure special pensions for community health agents and vector control workers, underscoring the political courage required to tackle a controversial issue. The legislative process faced criticism from FIESP and opposition lawmakers, who warned of increased labor informality and rising employer costs. Alcolumbre emphasized state recognition of the beneficiaries, affirming the significance of their service.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro tinha razão sobre Ciro Gomes?
item.description: The alliance between Ciro Gomes (PSDB) and PL in Ceará, which led to Roberto Cláudio (União Brasil) supporting Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), reignited the conflict involving Michelle Bolsonaro and parts of the Bolsonaro family. Michelle had previously criticized Ciro Gomes, though he remains neutral in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Artigo: do salto alto nas campanhas ao fim da escala 6x1, como eleitores indecisos veem movimentos do 2º turno
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections' second round is marked by uncertainty and polarization, with undecided voters struggling to choose between candidates, particularly amid controversial proposals such as the 6x1 scale. The campaign reveals tensions between the desire for change and the reaction of conservative sectors, affecting electoral dynamics and the emotional wear on voters.

item.title: Meta nega interferência política nas eleições do Brasil e cita 'incidentes técnicos' em redes de Lula
item.description: Meta stated it does not engage in political interference in the Brazilian elections, attributing suspensions and technical errors to flaws in its protection and AI classification systems. The TSE ordered Meta not to block political content from Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro under penalty of daily fines. Lula's campaign accuses Meta of repeated failures in delivering posts.

item.title: Paes entra de cabeça na campanha de Lula e fará evento com lideranças comunitárias atrás de votos para o petista
item.description: Following his defeat in the Rio de Janeiro state election, former mayor Eduardo Paes has decided to actively support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign, scheduling an event with community leaders in the saquarema. Previously, Paes maintained a strategic distance from Lula, avoiding public appearances and direct mentions in the media, a stance that did not prevent the victory of Douglas Ruas, an ally of Flávio Dóuglas.

item.title: Campanha de Lula reforçará que comparecimento no 2º turno serve como prova de vida do INSS
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's reelection campaign intends to emphasize that voting in the second round serves as proof of life for retired and pensioner citizens, encouraging elderly participation. This strategy was previously referenced during the first round of elections.
